scripts.check: npm run skill:check && cargo fmt --all -- --check && cargo check --workspace && npm --prefix apps/desktop run check
scripts.test: cargo test --workspace && npm --prefix apps/desktop run build && npm run test:packaging && npm run test:smoke && npm run test:e2e
scripts.test:e2e: cargo build -p orchestra-core -p orchestra-cli && node apps/desktop/terminal-v2-gate.js
scripts.build:core: npm run skill:sync && cargo build --release -p orchestra-core -p orchestra-cli
scripts.package:deb: npm run build:core && npm run verify:package-resources && npm --prefix apps/desktop run package:deb
scripts.package:appimage: npm run build:core && npm run verify:package-resources && npm --prefix apps/desktop run package:appimage
scripts.package:all: npm run build:core && npm run verify:package-resources && npm --prefix apps/desktop run package:all
scripts.package:dir: npm run build:core && npm run verify:package-resources && npm --prefix apps/desktop run package:dir
